display_title: Between Question Mark and Question Mark
description:
Cho Seyan wakes up to see people with signs on their heads saying their relationship to her. She's happy to see her crush's sign saying "Boyfriend?", but her childhood friend has the same sign. With two guys who will potentially become her lover, which one will Cho Seyan choose?
